text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Kikuka Sho and Satono Diamond is cool and collected. She hasn't said the word jinx even once.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's incredibly focused, even in the paddock. Sensing that Satono Diamond's going to put on a great race, Kitasan Black gives her approval from the stands.
